criteria.text: Every proposed quote must exist exactly in its current trusted issue or code source before any batch mutation.
Missing, changed, inaccessible, unavailable or untrusted evidence holds the batch; a matching quote does not determine a relation.
Evidence and authority are checked again before an effect if observations can have changed.

cases.given: Five agent classifications cite current exact trusted quotes
cases.required_observation: Each quote is checked without inferring any classification.

cases.given: One of several quotes is missing, empty, changed, inaccessible or untrusted
A source revision or authority changes after validation
cases.required_observation: The effect is held until current evidence and authority are valid.

cases.given: The current revision cannot be read
cases.required_observation: The whole batch has zero writes and reports the held source.

cases.given: The issue comment author is not trusted
cases.required_observation: The whole batch has zero writes and reports the held source.

cases.given: The code locator escapes the checkout
cases.required_observation: The whole batch has zero writes and reports the held source.

cases.given: The exact quote is absent from the cited revision
cases.required_observation: The whole batch has zero writes and reports the held source.
